_comment_keywords: Extracted from your resume by configure.py. Edit freely -- these drive 55% of the Fit Score.

targeting._comment: Use the job titles employers post, not your internal title.

sources._comment: ats_boards is the primary source. The token is the company slug in their careers URL: boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.lever.co/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>.
sources._comment_google: Google's public careers endpoints stopped returning a usable payload. Off by default; set true to try again.

scoring._comment: min_fit_score is the volume dial. 55 is a sane start; raise to 70 for fewer, sharper matches.

schedule._comment: cron_utc is generated by configure.py from local_time + timezone. GitHub cron is UTC-only and DST-blind.
